Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Medical assistants annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Medical Assistants ($61,500). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $61,500, Chicago $47,270, Austin $45,820. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Medical assistants?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Medical Assistants (15,640 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 15,640, Seattle 10,210, Austin 5,830. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Medical assistants most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Seattle has the highest published location quotient (0.93). Published LQs: Seattle 0.93, Austin 0.86, Chicago 0.66.

What is the hourly median for Medical assistants in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $22.03; Chicago $22.73; Seattle $29.57. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
